refs.note: Guide to Andalucia: the Avenida de la Constitución Christmas market runs along the avenue toward the Cathedral and Giralda, with wooden stalls. Seville also has the Feria del Belén, Plaza Nueva, and the Paseo de Cristina craft fair; this scene is the avenue market only.
Seville Traveller: several concurrent Christmas markets, including a relocated craft fair and Plaza Nueva. Used to avoid treating one market as the only market.
